Rhea Seehorn wins her first Emmy for ‘Pluribus as Carol Sturka in the Apple TV+ series .

Seehorn, who plays one of the last independent-thinking humans on Earth in the Vince Gilligan-created series, became emotional while accepting the award.Sorry, this is me on a beta blocker. It’s pretty bad,” Seehorn said as she took the stage.

“Thank you to the Television Academy so much and all the members that voted. And I also just want to say congratulations and thank you for the performances to my fellow nominees in my category. All brilliant, brilliant performances, Keri Russell among them, who sent us a lovely gift and a card, quoting sadly, we didn’t know we would lose her so soon  but quoting Gloria Steinem, saying, ‘We are linked, not ranked.’ And I feel that way about all you women.”
